The '''T-65B X-wing starfighter''' was a modified version of the standard [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] produced by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. They were faster, more updated fighters compared to their predecessors.

==Characteristics==
The T-65B was considered an excellent all-round starfighter requiring very little adjustment for most mission profiles. The craft supported many advanced technologies including modest shields, heavy weaponry, and a hyperdrive unit. In spite of this, the X-wing was still very easy to fly.<ref name="sotg">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> The controls were designed to mimic [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|civilian ships]] already on the market. This made the switch for new pilots much easier.<ref name="resb">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> Flown by one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], the T-65B carried four [[KX9 laser cannon/Legends|KX9 laser cannons]] and two [[MG7 proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launchers]]. The engines were four Incom [[4L4 fusial thrust engine/Legends|4L4 fusial thrust engines]]. A craft with this sturdy a design and ease of use was essential to the survival of Rebel Alliance pilots.<ref name="sotg" /> The starfighter had a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] canopy, [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and a [[Chempat Shield Generator]]. The craft was also equipped with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] in the nose cone.<ref name="RS I guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref> The X-wing was still slower than and not as heavily armed as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]].<ref name="LSSM" />

Each T-65B was equipped with an astromech droid. The droid was used in place of a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] for calculating [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps. In addition to its primary function, the droid could also be used for inflight repairs, enhancing the durability of an already rugged design.<ref name="sotg" /> The X-wing carried four [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] which deployed into an "X"-shape, giving the craft its name. The laser cannons were mounted on the tips of the wings. The proton torpedo launchers could be replaced by [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]].<ref name="RS I guide" />

==History==
[[File:AmbushAtMosEisley-RogueSquadron.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Skywalker flying his X-wing over [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].]]
The T-65B was the primary [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="SWDB">''[[StarWars.com]] Databank: X-Wing'' Entry</ref><ref name="SWSB"/><ref name="RASB">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> Its development began in secret when the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] first started sympathizing with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] cause.<ref name="rgsa">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> It was present early in the rebellion and later became a symbol for Alliance [[Space denial|tactics]]. "Hit fast and hard, and take advantage of all opportunities presented to you." The Alliance later developed the [[T-65C-A2 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65C-A2]], but these ships were rare. Most Rebel X-wing pilots flew the B model.<ref name="SWSB" /><ref name="RASB" /> The Rebels liberated Incom storehouses to acquire the starfighters, then shared the plans with other shipbuilders. As a result of the low numbers, the Alliance limited the craft's use. 70% of sorties were on reconnaissance missions, although the X-wings earned its reputation on strikes against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] projects.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] flew the T-65B at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="KSWT">''[[Kenner Products|Kenner]] Character Bio: Luke Skywalker in X-Wing Pilot Gear (1995, POTF)</ref> [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] flew the T-65B in their strikes against the Empire.<ref name="RS I guide" />

Turncoat [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Ral Shawgrim]] attempted to deliver a near-complete set of plans for the starfighter to [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] some time after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. However, despite his escape, the plans were retrieved.<ref name="Cracken">{{JournalCite|1|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>

At least some members of Rogue Squadron were piloting the starfighter during the [[Battle of Mindor|campaign]] against [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]]. Rogue Squadron's T-65B fighters were used to deploy [[flechette torpedo]]es at the [[Battle of the Corellian Queen|Battle of the ''Corellian Queen'']].<ref name="LSSM" />
